scope: oak_attestation_verification/testdata: turin-report.bin is root_layer.remote_attestation_report in turin_oc_evidence.binarypb, a version 5 report from a Turin processor (CPUID family 0x1a, model 0x02) on firmware 1.55.61. turin-vcek.der is oak_containers.root_layer.tee_certificate in turin_oc_endorsements.binarypb, the VCEK that AMD's KDS issued for it on 2025-07-17. Oak's Milan and Genoa evidence repeats report versions, firmware and certificate kinds that other fixtures already cover.
